description: The room map, as GET /v1/events/{event_id}/groups returns it. A list, so the empty case is a real answer and not an error.

valid.why: an empty room: a valid successful response, and the only thing that may render 'No tables yet'
two seated tables for a paid organizer, who is sent names
the same room for a free organizer: the shape of the tables without a single name
a table with no members yet is still a table

invalid.why: a bare object where the list belongs
a table with no place in the room
no colour, which is how a table is told apart across the room
members missing entirely rather than empty
a member who has not said whether they found their group
a display name that is not a name
members as an object rather than a list, which iterates as nothing instead of failing
